title: Lithuania and Ukraine turn drone and electronic-warfare cooperation into a planned joint venture before production is visible
source_unit: Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence account of Pekkla UAB and December One RND UAV/EW cooperation
geography: Lithuania and Ukraine; Pekkla UAB and December One RND Ltd; planned Lithuanian joint venture

observations.period: October 15, 2026; Letter of Intent and planned-production announcement

denominator.unit: named Lithuania–Ukraine UAV and electronic-warfare cooperation route

cooperation_stage.value: Pekkla UAB and Ukraine's December One RND Ltd signed a Letter of Intent on production and supply of electronic-warfare systems and UAV components

planned_joint_venture.value: the ministry reports an aim to establish a joint venture in Lithuania

lithuanian_contribution.value: Pekkla provides existing infrastructure, Lithuanian business contacts, regulation advice, and a commercial platform

ukrainian_contribution.value: December One RND contributes R&D insights, technical expertise, production capabilities, and product concepts for testing on the Lithuanian market

realization_and_effect.unit: missing binding joint-venture formation, ownership, financing, technology transfer, testing, certification, facility, production, customers, delivery, operational use, jobs, resilience, and public/local response

mechanism.value: A named Letter of Intent can create a cross-border pathway for technology and production localization, but planned joint-venture formation and a 2027 target are not realized production or capability.

observations.method: Structured extraction from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence announcement. Letter of Intent, joint-venture objective, production target, firm contributions, and unmeasured realization and effects are coded as separate stages.
observations.uncertainty: The announcement does not establish binding joint-venture formation, ownership, financing, transfer completion, testing, certification, facility, output, customers, deliveries, actual jobs, supply substitution, operational use, or public acceptance.
observations.subgroup: Pekkla UAB, December One RND, Lithuanian and Ukrainian defense institutions, future workers and suppliers, potential Ukrainian and Lithuanian users, and local communities; no affected-person denominator is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: Cooperation may shorten logistics and transfer battlefield-relevant knowledge, while a Letter of Intent can remain nonbinding, face technical or regulatory failure, depend on external inputs, and produce no local output or jobs.

boundary: This record establishes a reported Letter of Intent between Pekkla UAB and December One RND, a planned Lithuanian joint venture, and a stated 2027 production aim for UAV components and electronic-warfare systems. It does not establish binding formation, technology transfer, testing, production, delivery, operational use, realized resilience, jobs, or public legitimacy.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the compact project follow-up memo derived from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence source; Letter-of-Intent terms, corporate records, production data, test results, and local-outcome data are not retained.
